Using only the browser tool, open https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Reference/Status. Find the HTTP status for a client rate-limited after too many requests, open its linked detail page from the index, verify the heading and URL, and report the code.

Using only the browser tool, open https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Reference/Status. Find the client-error status used when a server requires a conditional update to prevent a lost write. Follow its linked detail page, verify the heading and URL, and report the code.

Using only the browser tool, open https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-page. Find the Page method that waits for a network response matching a URL or predicate. Open its method entry from the index, verify the URL anchor and section, and report its method name.
